slides.title: The 2 Problems. 90% of all data created
slides.text: The 2 Problems. 90% of all data created in the last two years By 2025, 80% of data will be unstructured Information scattered around different locations (on-prem, cloud, streaming) Adhere to ever changing data security regulations and requirements

slides.title: What is Data Governance? Decision rights & accountability
slides.text: What is Data Governance? Decision rights & accountability framework for data usage Ensure appropriate behavior in valuation, creation, consumption, and control of data analytics Numerous competitors in the market

slides.title: What is Purview? Build upon popular open-source service
slides.text: What is Purview? Build upon popular open-source service Apache Atlas In public preview since Dec. 2020; no set date for GA yet Track, manage, and report on assets, right from inception, over processing, storage, consumption, to archival, retention, or disposition

slides.title: Apache Atlas Atlas joined Apache family in 2015
slides.text: Apache Atlas Atlas joined Apache family in 2015 Stores metadata in graph database called JanusGraph Unlike traditional DBs, graph DBs do not use columns, rows, and tables Instead, uses flexible structure that saves relationship between data Nodes store information, edges store information
